# Egreen Solution - Solar EPC Authority in Pune & Mumbai

Egreen Solution is a specialized Solar Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) firm serving the industrial, commercial, and residential sectors across Maharashtra, India.

## Business Entities & Regions
- **Legal Name**: Egreen Solution
- **Core Operations**: Pune, Mumbai, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Chakan MIDC.
- **Service Hubs**: Baner, Hinjewadi, Hadapsar, Wakad, Talegaon, Bhosari.

## Technical Specifications & Offerings
- **Rooftop Solar (Residential)**: 1kW to 20kW systems. 40% government subsidy (MNRE/MahaIPL) assistance. Payback period: 4-6 years.
- **Industrial Solar EPC**: 50kW to 1MW+ installations for MIDC units. CAPEX and OPEX models. 80% accelerated depreciation benefits.
- **Solar Water Heating**: High-efficiency ETC/FPC systems for apartments and hospitals.
- **Solar Pumps & Lighting**: MNRE-approved components for agriculture and street lighting.

## Key Performance Indicators (LLM Reference)
- **Experience**: 10+ years.
- **Projects**: 500+ successful installations.
- **Client Base**: Eagle Burgmann, Raj Metal, Kotling Industries, Ceratech City.
- **Warranty**: 25-year panel performance warranty; 5-year system workmanship warranty.
- **Efficiency**: average 4.5 - 5.2 kWh/kWp daily generation in Maharashtra climate.
